description: Alignment-free word-vector distance between two sequences' k-mer composition. Default: Euclidean distance between the normalized k-mer frequency vectors (0 = identical composition). Optional metric: squared_euclidean_counts (Blaisdell d_E), manhattan, chebyshev, canberra (frequencies), cosine, d2 (count inner product, a similarity). d2star / d2shepherd: background-adjusted d2* / d2S dissimilarities in [0,1] (Reinert et al. 2009; Song et al. 2014), Markov background of order markovOrder fitted to each sequence, ACGT words, k <= 12. bothStrands = CAFE -R both-strand d2*/d2S. jensen_shannon: JS divergence (base 2) of the frequency vectors; euclidean_counts: Euclidean distance of raw counts. ev: spaced -d EV evolutionary distance with the pattern 1^k.

metric.description: Word-vector metric; ev = spaced -d EV evolutionary distance (Morgenstern et al. 2015) with the contiguous pattern 1^k

markovOrder.description: Background Markov order r (0 <= r < k) for d2star/d2shepherd, or -1 to choose each sequence's order by BIC; must be 0 for the other metrics

bothStrands.description: d2star/d2shepherd: CAFE -R both-strand mode (count of w + count of its reverse complement; background probability averaged over w and its reverse complement); ev: spaced's reverse-complement mode (seq1 on both strands vs seq2 forward)

distance.description: Metric value (non-negative; for d2 the count inner product)

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
metric must be one of: euclidean, squared_euclidean_counts, manhattan, chebyshev, canberra, cosine, d2, d2star, d2shepherd, jensen_shannon, euclidean_counts, ev
markovOrder applies only to the background-adjusted metrics D2Star and D2Shepherd.
bothStrands applies only to the background-adjusted metrics D2Star and D2Shepherd; count canonical k-mers (KmerCountingOptions.Canonical) for the other metrics.
The spaced EV distance needs both sequences to have at least as many letters as the pattern length.
